description: This file implements the CBC cipher mode for AES encryption within the AWS SDK cryptography module. It provides methods for initializing the cipher, getting cipher parameters, managing IVs, and updating the IV based on ciphertext blocks.

classes.name: Cbc
classes.description: A class implementing CBC mode encryption and decryption for AES, designed for use with AWS cryptographic streams. It manages IVs and encapsulates cipher configuration details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a CBC cipher instance with a specified IV and key size, validating the IV length.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method name based on key size, e.g., 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the AES cipher configuration, here 'AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector being used.

methods.name: requiresPadding
methods.description: Indicates that padding is required for this cipher mode, always returns true.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets the IV to the original base IV if seeking to position zero; throws an exception for arbitrary seeks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the IV based on the latest ciphertext block, effectively moving the cipher's state forward.
